# PR Enterprises

> Clean solar energy solutions and rooftop solar installations in Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

PR Enterprises is a solar energy solutions provider based in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India. The company specializes in rooftop solar panel installations for residential and commercial properties, offering end-to-end services including site assessment, system design, and professional installation.

## Services Offered
- **Residential Rooftop Solar:** Solar panel installations tailored for residential homes and rooftop structures.
- **Commercial Solar Solutions:** Custom solar power setups for commercial and business facilities to reduce operational electricity costs.
- **On-Grid & Hybrid Solar Systems:** Grid-connected solar power setups and battery-backed hybrid solutions.
- **Site Assessment & Engineering:** Professional rooftop evaluation, structure planning, and custom system design.
- **Installation & Commissioning:** Safe, compliant solar panel mounting, inverter setup, and grid synchronization.

## Consultation & Inquiries
Consultations and site evaluations can be requested directly by phone or WhatsApp at +91 7742775973. System sizing and pricing are determined based on monthly electricity consumption, available shadow-free rooftop area, and sanctioned power load.
